channel.title: GRAVITY Research Notes
channel.description: GRAVITY: Game-Rate Adjusted Value, Impact, Talent, and Yield. An independent basketball research publication — numbered notes, registered forecasts, annual audits.

item.title: Research Note No. 2 — The Queta Problem: why he’s a top-50 player, and why 2026-27 proves it
item.description: A prediction paper. GRAVITY ranked Neemias Queta #41; this note attacks the number twice (an empirical on/off noise model, a 33-season comparables engine), keeps what survives, and registers the forecast: 75% top-50 by July 2027, falsification criteria on the record. PDF: papers/queta.pdf

item.title: Research Note No. 1 — The Rise and Fall of Ja Morant: a statistical account, 2017–2026
item.description: Seven seasons, one instrument. The collapse was 88% shot-making and 12% shot-selection; the three-point crash fits inside its own confidence interval; the free throw improved significantly; and the college assist rate the draft model ignored was a +3.5σ outlier. PDF: papers/morant.pdf
